scope: The public current Posten postcode landing page, manual and complete register plus the Kartverket/data.norge Postnummerområder metadata, WFS/Atom endpoints and CC BY 4.0 legal code were audited without provider contact, registration, authentication, terms or contract acceptance, payment, protected address/property query, publication destination or deployment.

countryIdentity.rule: Repository identity remains SJ and ledger region Europe. Posten county-like 21 Svalbard and 22 Jan Mayen fields are retained as operational source classifications, not ordinary counties, and are not silently merged into NO or into one another.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete Posten four-digit assignment/category denominator whose county-like 21 Svalbard and 22 Jan Mayen rows are usable under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Every SJ area code is reconciled to a valid fixed Kartverket Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon under CC BY 4.0, while P.O.-box, special, route, point, unmatched and other source-defined non-area records remain explicit. Source 21/22 classifications and repository SJ identity are preserved without merging NO. The approved immutable artifact pins provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, conflicts and exceptions. The real SJ API/app normalizes NNNN text, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; no municipality, settlement, island, administrative boundary, Point, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.

officialObservations.finding: Posten says the tables contain all postcodes used for addressing mail in Norway and are valid from 2025-10-01. The exact current Windows-1252 TAB body has 5,122 unique well-formed rows.

The manual defines G street-address, P P.O.-box, B combined and S special-service categories. It states that Svalbard and Jan Mayen are not ordinary counties and uses 21/22 only to distinguish their postcodes.

Filtering the validated complete register by municipality-code prefixes 21 and 22 yields exactly eight unique SJ rows: 8099 Jan Mayen (G); 9170 Longyearbyen (G); 9171 Longyearbyen (P); 9173 Ny-Ålesund (B); 9174 Hopen (G); 9175 Sveagruva (G); 9176 Bjørnøya (G); and 9178 Barentsburg (G). Public download availability did not establish explicit AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving permission.

The governmental catalogue identifies official postcode extents, says P.O.-box codes are additional, advertises GeoJSON/GML/GDB/SOSI and WFS/WMS/Geonorge access, reports monthly updates, labels distributions CC BY 4.0 and records metadata modified 2026-08-28. It does not enumerate SJ coverage in the metadata page.

Five ordinary public download attempts across HTTPS/HTTP Atom, WFS capabilities and a one-feature GeoJSON request timed out during TCP connection after 15-20 seconds. This is availability evidence only, not proof that SJ geometry is absent. No response or geometry body was fixed.

rightsAssessment.note: This is a conservative engineering gate, not legal advice. Kartverket CC BY 4.0 covers its distributions but does not license Posten assignment/category rows, and a free download was not silently widened into production permission.

browserReview.reason: No fixed current SJ geometry, complete area/non-area reconciliation or rights-cleared approved artifact exists. Operator rows, points, territory outlines and synthetic fixtures were not staged as production postcode areas.

reportPresentation.reason: The gate table and exact eight-row denominator communicate the decisive rights and zero-geometry gap more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The current Posten register yields eight exact SJ assignments and source-defined G/P/B categories, but no explicit Posten permission compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving was established. Kartverket advertises official postcode areas under CC BY 4.0, yet all WFS/Atom geometry attempts timed out and neither SJ coverage nor a fixed geometry body, digest, topology audit or eight-code area/non-area reconciliation was produced. No approved immutable artifact or real SJ loader/API/map path can be promoted.
unblockConditions: Establish explicit written Posten terms compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving for the complete assignment/category denominator, or an equivalent expressly open current complete source.

Download and pin a fixed current Kartverket Postnummerområder distribution under CC BY 4.0 with edition, reference date, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage and exclusions, and verify whether each of the eight SJ codes is within product coverage.

Reconcile all eight codes to valid Polygon/MultiPolygon features or explicit source-defined non-area reasons while retaining G/P/B/S and 21/22 fields and repository SJ identity; infer nothing from missing geometry and use no Point, municipality, settlement, island, administration, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy.
Build and publish only an approved immutable artifact, then pass real SJ normalization, loader, API validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
